name: Robin Gilly
source:
A not-so-sweet rocker girl. She is kicked out of the band that she helped found. Bitter, she vows to make her own band and surpass them. Things get more complicated when she's forced to travel to her past life to do it.
[From [url=https://happybackwards.itch.io/rockrobin]Itch.io[/url]]
